name: crypto-research
description: Crypto research reports — token & theme deep-dives (market data, fundamentals, narrative, catalysts, risks, levels). Read-only; works on CoinGecko's free API, no key required.

env.prompt: CoinGecko Pro API key (OPTIONAL — leave blank for the free API)

notes: Works out of the box on CoinGecko's free API (no key, ~30 calls/min). Add a CoinGecko Pro/Demo key for higher limits. The persona researches via web search + market data and writes a structured report — read-only, it never touches funds.
